purpose: Default registry read by game/scripts/exploration_sprite_set_pilot.gd when -- --exploration-sprite-set-pilot is given without --exploration-sprite-set-registry=. It maps actor ids (protagonist-female, protagonist-male, ...) to set manifests (schema worlds-between.exploration-sprite-set.v1).
status: No high-density exploration set is approved, so this registry lists none and every actor keeps the legacy 32x48 textures even with the flag. Adding a set here is a content/approval decision, not part of the pilot capability.
